blind.description: A freestanding tripod metal brazier composed of a shallow circular bowl filled with textured grey ash and black charcoal/cinders. The bowl is supported by three ornate legs styled with beast or lion heads at the top brackets and clawed feet at the base, braced together near the bottom by a solid circular ring stretcher. Surfaces are smooth and continuous with realistic weathered bronze/brass patina, sitting directly on its three claw feet.
blind.from_above: A circular dark metallic rim framing an inner basin filled with rough, unevenly textured dark grey and black ashes and coals.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 45% as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2.5 to 2.8 ft tall) and about one-third as wide as the figure is tall.
